violations.text: Proper cooling methods were not used for time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods. Peppers and veggies was placed hot in the refrigerator in containers greater than four inches deep and covered. Foods were moved to shallow pans to properly cool. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/02/2026

The door to the outside, located neat the server drink station, is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. Per PIC, a work order has been placed for repairs. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 11/03/2026

The chlorine sanitizer concentration for the sanitizing cycle of the dishwashern (glass washer) was 0 parts per million (ppm). Chlorine sanitizing solutions must be between 50-100 ppm. Service request made at the time of inspection. All glassware to be washed and sanitized at main dishwasher. New Violation. Correct By: 10/20/2026

Bolognese, broccoli, and chicken was observed held at 41-50 degrees Fahrenheit in the flip top prep units. Food was observed stored over the fill line of the hotel pans. Staff must keep food below the fill line to maintain adequate temperatures. Foods moved to refrigeration to rapidly cool. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 10/20/2026

Proper cooling methods were not used for time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods. Quinoa and pasta was placed hot in containers deeper than 4 inches on the cooling racks. Proper cooling methods reviewed with PIC at time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 10/20/2026

Chicken was observed thawing in stagnant water at the cooling rack. Food moved to walk-in cooler to properly thaw. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods must be thawed in one of the following manners: under refrigeration (41 degrees Fahrenheit or less); completely submerged under running water; as part of the cooking process; or in the microwave if cooked immediately after thawing. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 10/20/2026

The door to the outside, located neat the server drink station, is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 11/03/2026

The cutting boards in the food prep room and on the prep unit at the cookline are very scratched and scored. Cutting blocks and boards that are subject to scratching and scoring shall be resurfaced if they can no longer be effectively cleaned and sanitized, or discarded if they are not capable of being resurfaced. New Violation. Correct By: 10/20/2026

The non-food contact surfaces of the ice machines have an accumulations of pink and black residue. The ice machines must be cleaned as often as necessary to prevent the possible contamination of ice. New Violation. Correct By: 10/20/2026

The sink in the employees bathroom, at the end of the cookline near the server drink station, and the one at the bar entrance was observed with a water temperature below 85 Degrees Fahrenheit. Hot water generation and distribution systems shall be sufficient to meet the peak hot water demands throughout the FOOD ESTABLISHMENT. New Violation. Correct By: 10/20/2026

The chlorine sanitizer concentration for the sanitizing cycle of the glass washer in the kitchen was 0 parts per million (ppm). Chlorine sanitizing solutions must be between 50-100 ppm. Establishment to discontinue use of dishwasher until it can be repaired/replaced/serviced. Per PIC, dishwasher was serviced 8/6/25. PIC has requested another maintenance service. New Violation. Correct By: 08/18/2025

The door to the outside, located in the back of the prep kitchen, is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. PIC has requested a maintenance service and is pending repairs. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 08/18/2025

The chlorine sanitizer concentration for the sanitizing cycle of the glass washer in the kitchen was 0 parts per million (ppm). Chlorine sanitizing solutions must be between 50-100 ppm. Establishment to discontinue use of dishwasher until it can be repaired/replaced/serviced. New Violation. Correct By: 08/04/2025

Various food items were observed held at 45-50 degrees Fahrenheit in the prep unit in various refrigeration units at the cookline. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Per PIC, all foods are taken from the walk-in cooler at the beginning of the shift and placed into the prep units (2 hours prior of inspection). PIC and staff informed to not fill food above the fill line in the hotel pans. Foods were moved to different refrigeration to properly cool. Units observed with ambient temperatures over 41 degrees Fahrenheit are to not be used to hold food until they can be repaired/replaced/serviced. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/04/2025

Proper cooling methods were not used for time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods. Pasta and other foods were placed hot in the refrigerator in containers greater than four inches deep. Proper cooling methods and procedures reviewed with PIC. Foods moved to sheet pans to properly cool. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/04/2025

Reduced oxygen packaged lobster labeled "KEEP FROZEN" was observed thawing with the package in-tact. Reduced oxygen packaged seafoods labeled "KEEP FROZEN" must be removed from the packaging upon thawing. Lobster was observed over 38 degrees Fahrenheit. Person in charge voluntarily disposed of food. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/04/2025

The door to the outside, located in the back of the prep kitchen, is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 08/18/2025

The third prep unit from the batter/breading station was observed in poor repair (maintaining ambient temperature of 49 degrees Fahrenheit). Unit to not be used until it can be replaced/serviced/repaired. New Violation. Correct By: 08/04/2025

The non-food contact surfaces of the ice machine has an accumulation of pink residue. The non-food contact surfaces of the ice machine must be cleaned as often as necessary. New Violation. Correct By: 08/04/2025

Cheese sauce, which was prepared in advance, was not cooled to 70 degrees Fahrenheit in 2 hours and then to 41 degrees Fahrenheit within 4 hours.PIC voluntarily disposed of product. Corrected On-Site. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 11/16/2023
